The answer waits about 1.2 s (refresh.wait) for the refresh to settle: settled, it is 201 with the outcome; still open, it is 202 with state pending and its place in the queue; either way Location names the refresh, which GET reads again. An unknown source is a 400 naming body.source; a subject the source refuses is a 400 naming the field (body.subject.at, say). No provider data is ever in this answer.
